applet.name: Macchina Inutile — Suspended Spar
applet.description: A zero-utility spatial mobile suspended inside the chat viewport. Translates ambient browser geometry, cursor drift, and conversational drafts into kinetic balance and cast shadows.
applet.author: Student Name

stateSchema.description: Passive kinetic equilibrium read by the conversational host.

angleRadians.description: Current angular displacement of the balsa spar.

agitationLevel.description: Qualitative summary of environmental air currents.

idleSeconds.description: Seconds elapsed since the human last disturbed the viewport.

disturb_air.description: Introduce a subtle conversational air current into the applet's environment (e.g., when the model responds or changes tone).

impulse.description: Directional breeze strength (-1.0 left draft, +1.0 right draft).

temperature.description: Shifts the viscosity/damping of the surrounding air.
